    moves.append([n, source, target])
    hanoi(n-1, aux, target, source)

hanoi(8, 0, 2, 1)
print(len(moves))
# Output moves in batches of 25
for i in range(0, len(moves), 25):
    batch = moves[i:i+25]
    print(json.dumps(batch))
PY"}
